title: Kiểm tra tuần 4: Hiện tại hoàn thành và tổng ôn nền tảng
title_en: Week 4 test: Present perfect and foundation review
passage: Last year, my doctor told me that I had to change my lifestyle. I spent too much time on my phone and I didn't do any exercise. Since then, I have made some big changes. I have started walking to work every day, and I have stopped drinking soft drinks. I have also joined a club which cleans up the beach every month. The people who work with me there are very friendly. Together, we have collected thousands of plastic bottles. I think everyone should try to live a healthier life because it is good for us and for the environment. I have never felt better!

questions.explain: Hiện tại hoàn thành: have + V3; V3 của eat là eaten.
questions.explain_en: Present perfect: have + past participle; the past participle of eat is eaten.

questions.q: A doctor is a person ___ helps sick people.
questions.explain: Thay cho người (a person) dùng đại từ quan hệ who.
questions.explain_en: For a person (a person) we use the relative pronoun who.

questions.q: I ___ to Phu Quoc last summer.
questions.explain: 'last summer' là thời điểm xác định trong quá khứ nên dùng quá khứ đơn.
questions.explain_en: 'Last summer' is a definite past time, so we use the past simple.

questions.q: There ___ many people at the party last night.
questions.explain: Ôn tập: 'people' số nhiều và 'last night' là quá khứ → There were.
questions.explain_en: Review: 'people' is plural and 'last night' is past → There were.

questions.q: You have a bad cough. You ___ see a doctor.
questions.explain: Lời khuyên dùng should + V nguyên mẫu (không có to).
questions.explain_en: For advice use should + base verb (no to).

questions.q: In Vietnam, drivers ___ stop at a red light.
questions.explain: Quy định bắt buộc, chủ ngữ số nhiều 'drivers' → have to + V.
questions.explain_en: It is a rule and 'drivers' is plural → have to + verb.

questions.q: I enjoy ___ to music in the evening.
We decided ___ more trees in our garden.
questions.explain_en: After decide we use to + verb.

questions.explain: pollution = ô nhiễm; population = dân số.
questions.explain_en: pollution = ô nhiễm; population = dân số.

questions.q: To stay healthy, you should ___ exercise every day.
questions.explain: Cụm cố định: do exercise (tập thể dục).

questions.q: My phone's battery is low. I need to ___ it.
questions.explain_en: When the battery is low you need to charge it.

questions.q: We should ___ plastic bottles instead of throwing them away.
questions.explain: recycle = tái chế, thay vì vứt đi.
questions.explain_en: Recycle means using things again instead of throwing them away.

questions.q: What does the writer's club do every month?
questions.explain: Bài đọc viết: 'a club which cleans up the beach every month'.
questions.explain_en: The passage says: 'a club which cleans up the beach every month'.

questions.q: In the passage, the word 'lifestyle' means:
questions.explain: lifestyle = lối sống, tức là cách bạn sống hằng ngày.
questions.explain_en: Lifestyle means the way you live every day.

questions.q: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How the writer has changed their life
questions.explain: Bài đọc kể những thay đổi người viết đã làm để sống khỏe hơn.
questions.explain_en: The passage describes the changes the writer made to live a healthier life.
